newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - B.Stearns keeps IBM as attractive.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - B.Stearns keeps IBM as attractive.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns analyst Andrew Neff said he is maintaining his attractive rating on International Business Machines Corp and leaving unchanged his 1997 earnings estimate of $12.75 a share.
-- He said he is initiating an estimate of $14.50 a share for 1998.
-- "We were happy with the (1996 fourth) quarter and are encouraged about the outlook in view of services and PCs," Neff said.
-- "We see the potential for upturn in software and mainframes, sometime in mid-year, with more crossover to CMOS-based mainframes," he said, referring to IBM's next generation lower-cost mainframes.
